subject.title: fix(agents): keep capability URLs usable after transcript persistence

question: Should persisted agent transcripts retain raw URL query values for all `token`, `code`, and `signature` parameters, including bearer-style OAuth and signed-resource credentials?
rationale: The existing shared redaction policy treats these names as sensitive, while this PR changes only one storage boundary to retain them; choosing the acceptable replay-versus-retention tradeoff is a product security decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Use a capability-aware storage design
options.body: Preserve only explicitly classified replayable capabilities through a narrowly owned storage path while retaining default masking for generic sensitive query parameters.

options.title: Approve raw transcript retention
options.body: Document that persisted transcripts may retain capability-bearing URL credentials and accept the associated local-state and transcript-exposure risk.

recommendation.title: Use a capability-aware storage design
recommendation.body: Preserve only explicitly classified replayable capabilities through a narrowly owned storage path while retaining default masking for generic sensitive query parameters.
